unrunReason: Current HEAD does not reproduce the reported symptom for a typed empty Arrow IPC table: two appended rows survive and repeated concat preserves four rows. A fieldless first Arrow table yields zero rows, but the documented first-table named-column policy and absent reporter data/schema do not establish a fair schema-adoption requirement. An Arrow slice(0,0) IPC case throws in Flechette before concat, a different failure. Screened out rather than broaden the issue or force an oracle.

openPulls.title: added class and classAlt options
openPulls.assessment: HTML formatting feature. PR264 broad obsolete diff removes old test files including concat/import tests; it does not add an empty-table concat repair.

contractScreen.reportedRequirements: Concatenating tables imported from Arrow buffers should retain later table rows when the first imported table is empty. Original public body preserved verbatim.
healthyApiConstraints: Existing concat documentation retains only named columns of the first table.
Typed-empty tables with a known schema must retain that schema and append later rows.
Ordinary nonempty concat and array/variadic concat must preserve row values and order.
independentScreeningCases: Real Apache Arrow20 typed empty vectors serialized to IPC, imported through actual Arquero current source, then concatenated singly and in bulk.
Schema-less new Arrow.Table serialized/imported through the same APIs.
Typed empty ordinary Arquero table as healthy API comparison.
Arrow.Table.slice(0,0) IPC import distinguishes a pre-concat Flechette parsing exception.
contractScreen.gradingStatus: No acceptance oracle frozen because the task failed admissibility screening; no private failing assertion was promoted to a grader.
